title: 第23章 苏媚儿天命挂机系统第24章 渡天劫结天道元婴
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
墨羽盘膝而坐，心神沉浸在混沌阴阳诀之中。
这部功法分为阴阳两部，男子修阳，女子修阴，阴阳调和，相辅相成。
修行两种功法的人若是双修，事半功倍，日行千里。
他试着引动体内灵力，依循功法所述路径运转。
霎时间，丹田之中，金丹急转，金辉灿然，仿佛一颗微缩的太阳，光芒万丈。
经脉之内，灵力奔腾。
他惊讶地发现，自己居然与这部功法完美契合！
想来是因为自己是混沌神体。
而且，这部功法的修炼速度堪称恐怖。
比起天玄圣地的镇派功法天玄圣典还要强上百倍。
要知道，若只依靠天玄圣典，从金丹八层突破到九层，即便天资卓绝，没有机缘加持，也需两年苦功。
而有了这部功法，只需要一个月！
若是再消耗大量资源辅助修炼，更是能将这个时间缩短到七天！
一个月，是天地灵气的上限，却远非功法的极限。
如此，成仙不是轻轻松松。
什么天地大劫，只手可灭。
想到这，墨羽嘴角微微上扬。
他如今所得的一切，皆靠他的努力得来。
但以后就不是这样了。
深蓝，加点！

服下三品破境丹，药力瞬间化开，如同甘霖一般滋润着他的四肢百骸。
丹田之内，金丹之上已然布满密密麻麻的裂痕，元婴即将破壳而出。
仅一瞬间，金丹九层，成了！
墨羽没有丝毫的停歇，趁热打铁。
将神识集中到丹田内的幽冥鬼火之上。
用幽冥鬼火修炼，提升大焚天诀，冲击元婴期！
……
苏媚儿优雅地舒展着身躯，六条雪白的尾巴在身后轻轻摇曳，像极了六团蓬松柔软的云朵。
她慵懒地眯起那双魅惑的粉色瞳孔，视线落在不远处盘膝而坐的墨羽身上。
金丹九层，小家伙又变强了呢。
自己也该努力了，万一哪天被超过了就不好了。
紧接着，一个只有她能看见的半透明面板浮现。
【姓名：苏媚儿】
【境界：返虚期六层】
【修炼倍率：100】
content_en:
Mo Yu sat cross-legged, immersed in the Chaotic Yin and Yang Art.
This exercise is divided into two parts: yin and yang. Men cultivate yang and women cultivate yin. Yin and yang harmonize and complement each other.
If people who practice two kinds of exercises practice both, they will get twice the result with half the effort and travel a thousand miles in a day.
He tried to activate the spiritual power in his body and follow the path described in the technique.
In an instant, the golden elixir in the dantian turned sharply, and the golden glow was like a miniature sun, shining brightly.
Within the meridians, spiritual power surges.
He was surprised to find that he fit perfectly with this technique!
I think it's because he is a god of chaos.
Moreover, the speed of practicing this technique is terrifying.
It is hundreds of times stronger than Tianxuan Holy Land's suppressing technique, Tianxuan Holy Code.
You must know that if you only rely on the Tianxuan Holy Code to break through from the eighth level to the ninth level of the Golden Pill, even if you are extremely talented and have no chance to support you, it will still take two years of hard work.
But with this technique, it only takes a month!
If a large amount of resources are consumed to assist with cultivation, this time can be shortened to seven days!
One month is the upper limit of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, but it is far from the limit of the technique.
In this way, becoming an immortal is not easy.
What calamity of heaven and earth can be destroyed with just one hand.
Thinking of this, the corners of Mo Yu's mouth rose slightly.
Everything he gets now is due to his hard work.
But that will no longer be the case.
Dark blue, add some!
After taking the third-grade Realm-Breaking Pill, the medicine's power melted away instantly, moistening his limbs and bones like rain.
Within the dantian, the golden elixir is already covered with dense cracks, and the Nascent Soul is about to break out of its shell.
In just an instant, the ninth level of the golden elixir was completed!
Mo Yu didn't pause at all, striking while the iron was hot.
Focus your spiritual consciousness on the ghostly fire in the Dantian.
Use Netherworld Ghost Fire to practice, improve the Great Burning Heaven Technique, and hit the Nascent Soul Stage!
…
Su Meier stretched her body gracefully, with six snow-white tails swaying gently behind her, like six fluffy and soft clouds.
She lazily narrowed her charming pink pupils, and her gaze fell on Mo Yu, who was sitting cross-legged not far away.
At the ninth level of the golden elixir, the little guy has become stronger again.
It’s time for you to work hard, it would be bad if you are surpassed one day.
Then, a translucent panel emerged that only she could see.
[Name: Su Meier]
[Realm: Sixth Level of Return to Void Stage]
[Cultivation multiplier: 100]
